1	import { describe, it, expect, vi, afterEach } from 'vitest'
2	import { retry } from '../src/retry'
3	
4	afterEach(() => {
5	  vi.useRealTimers()
6	  vi.restoreAllMocks()
7	})
8	
9	describe('retry', () => {
10	  it('resolves with the value when fn succeeds on first attempt', async () => {
11	    const result = await retry(async () => 'ok', {
12	      maxAttempts: 3,
13	      baseDelayMs: 100,
14	      shouldRetry: () => true,
15	    })
16	    expect(result).toBe('ok')
17	  })
18	
19	  it('propagates the error immediately when shouldRetry returns false', async () => {
20	    let calls = 0
21	    const error = new Error('non-retryable')
22	    await expect(
23	      retry(
24	        async () => {
25	          calls++
26	          throw error
27	        },
28	        {
29	          maxAttempts: 5,
30	          baseDelayMs: 100,
31	          shouldRetry: () => false,
32	        }
33	      )
34	    ).rejects.toBe(error)
35	    expect(calls).toBe(1)
36	  })
37	
38	  it('retries until fn succeeds when shouldRetry returns true', async () => {
39	    let calls = 0
40	    const result = await retry(
41	      async () => {
42	        calls++
43	        if (calls < 3) throw new Error('flaky')
44	        return 'ok'
45	      },
46	      {
47	        maxAttempts: 5,
48	        baseDelayMs: 0,
49	        shouldRetry: () => true,
50	      }
51	    )
52	    expect(result).toBe('ok')
53	    expect(calls).toBe(3)
54	  })
55	
56	  it('stops after maxAttempts invocations and propagates the final error', async () => {
57	    let calls = 0
58	    const errors = [new Error('a'), new Error('b'), new Error('c')]
59	    await expect(
60	      retry(
61	        async () => {
62	          const error = errors[calls]
63	          calls++
64	          throw error
65	        },
66	        {
67	          maxAttempts: 3,
68	          baseDelayMs: 0,
69	          shouldRetry: () => true,
70	        }
71	      )
72	    ).rejects.toBe(errors[2])
73	    expect(calls).toBe(3)
74	  })
75	
76	  it('waits between failed attempts before retrying', async () => {
77	    vi.useFakeTimers()
78	    let calls = 0
79	    const promise = retry(
80	      async () => {
81	        calls++
82	        throw new Error('fail')
83	      },
84	      {
85	        maxAttempts: 2,
86	        baseDelayMs: 100,
87	        shouldRetry: () => true,
88	      }
89	    )
90	    promise.catch(() => {})
91	    await Promise.resolve()
92	    await Promise.resolve()
93	    expect(calls).toBe(1)
94	    expect(vi.getTimerCount()).toBe(1)
95	    await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(1000)
96	    await expect(promise).rejects.toThrow('fail')
97	    expect(calls).toBe(2)
98	  })
99	
100	  it('uses exponential backoff so delays grow with each retry', async () => {
101	    vi.useFakeTimers()
102	    vi.spyOn(Math, 'random').mockReturnValue(0)
103	    const setTimeoutSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout')
104	    const promise = retry(
105	      async () => {
106	        throw new Error('fail')
107	      },
108	      {
109	        maxAttempts: 4,
110	        baseDelayMs: 100,
111	        shouldRetry: () => true,
112	      }
113	    )
114	    promise.catch(() => {})
115	    await vi.runAllTimersAsync()
116	    await expect(promise).rejects.toThrow('fail')
117	    const delays = setTimeoutSpy.mock.calls.map((c) => c[1] as number)
118	    expect(delays).toEqual([100, 200, 400])
119	  })
120	
121	  it('applies jitter so equal exponential bases produce different delays', async () => {
122	    vi.useFakeTimers()
123	    vi.spyOn(Math, 'random').mockReturnValueOnce(0.25).mockReturnValueOnce(0.75)
124	    const setTimeoutSpy = vi.spyOn(globalThis, 'setTimeout')
125	    const promise = retry(
126	      async () => {
127	        throw new Error('fail')
128	      },
129	      {
130	        maxAttempts: 3,
131	        baseDelayMs: 100,
132	        shouldRetry: () => true,
133	      }
134	    )
135	    promise.catch(() => {})
136	    await vi.runAllTimersAsync()
137	    await expect(promise).rejects.toThrow('fail')
138	    const delays = setTimeoutSpy.mock.calls.map((c) => c[1] as number)
139	    expect(delays).toHaveLength(2)
140	    expect(delays[0]).not.toBe(delays[1])
141	    expect(delays[0]).toBeGreaterThan(100)
142	    expect(delays[1]).toBeGreaterThan(200)
143	  })
144	})
